messages:
maria-dev: Heads up — planning a staged apply for tenant isolation changes in tonight's change window (23:00 UTC). This touches networking + IAM roles for tenant VPCs. Need rollback criteria and version pin for the module. TL;DR: apply affects tenant-* route tables and cross-account role assumptions.

jonathan: +1. Which module/version are we pinning? can we keep old module around as fallback?

maria-dev: pin to git ref `refs/tags/tenant-isolation-v2.1.0` in the tf module source. fallback plan: if anything breaks, revert to `v2.0.4` and run `terraform apply -target=module.tenant_isolation` to restore routes.

samira: I drafted a rollback checklist: 1) Pause deploybot queue (infra-oncall). 2) Re-pin module in root module to `v2.0.4`. 3) `terraform apply -auto-approve -target=module.tenant_isolation`. 4) Validate cross-account role binding and traffic to control plane for 2 tenants. 5) Notify PGs.

alex: Can we do a tenant canary? apply to tenant-canary-1 first, then wait 10m, then ramp. If canary fails, run rollback on canary and abort full rollout.

maria-dev: yes — doing staged plan: canary (tenant-canary-1) -> 5 tenants -> all. Canary window 23:00-23:15. Full rollout 23:20-23:45. If canary fails, abort and follow rollback checklist.

deploy-bot: deploybot: preflight checks passed for branch `infra/tenant-isolation` — 3 approvals required, 4 present. Lockfile created. Queue position: 1. ETA: 4m. :white_check_mark:

infra-oncall: Holding on actual apply until we validate IAM role TTLs. We had that eventual consistency issue last month. Requesting a smoke script to validate role assume and metadata propagation before canary.

samira: I added smoke script to ops repo: `scripts/smoke/tenant-role-check.sh` — it tests assume-role and tries a control-plane API call. Plan output will be gated; I'll attach quick commands below:
```bash
# run smoke after canary apply
./scripts/smoke/tenant-role-check.sh tenant-canary-1
curl -sS https://control-plane.internal/health --header "Authorization: Bearer $TEST_TOKEN"
```

jonathan: Also storing current route table snapshots to S3 before apply: `s3://redwood-backups/route-snapshots/${ts}/tenant-canary-1.json`. If rollback needed we can diff and reapply routes.

maria-dev: good call. Add that to checklist. Also adding a hard timebox: if canary errors or increased 5xx >= 1% for 5m, trigger rollback.

alex: confirm metrics: `tenant.http.5xx_rate` and `tenant.latency.p50` monitored. I'll open a temporary dashboard and alert for 5m window.

deploy-bot: deploybot: queued job started: `tf-apply:infra/tenant-isolation@refs/tags/tenant-isolation-v2.1.0` — running plan for tenant-canary-1. live logs: https://ci.internal/jobs/12345 :package:

maria-dev: watching logs. tagging release notes: https://internal.releases/redwood/tenant-isolation/2.1.0 — includes IAM role scoping and route table modularization.

infra-oncall: smoke script ran against canary. result: assume-role ok, control-plane call succeeded. proceeding to staged rollout after 10m quiet window.

samira: canary plan applied and validated. moving to next batch of 5 tenants. Will run smoke for each batch.

jonathan: if any batch fails, run `terraform state rm module.tenant_isolation`? careful — that removes state. Prefer `terraform apply -target=module.tenant_isolation` to restore. Only remove state if we plan to re-import.

maria-dev: noted — don't rm state. Use targeted apply and re-pin.

deploy-bot: deploybot: full rollout completed for all tenants. Post-apply checks passed. :tada:

alex: I see no spike in 5xx, latency stable. reverting alert dashboard to normal. :thumbsup:

maria-dev: Great work team. I'll update release notes and archive the checklist. Leaving this thread open for 1h in case any late regressions show up.

infra-oncall: thanks all. Oncall monitoring for 1h. ping me if anything odd.
